source: Fixture for issue 470: a seam leak from the architecture review of a real triage run on a 15-file Go package (#468). Co-change counts come from an analogous file pair in another repo: last 200 non-merge commits, commits of 30 files or fewer.

candidates.claim: Prober.Step reads the StateMachine's private fail count through fails() and repeats its withdraw threshold from cfg.WithdrawAfter, with seeded and force flags for the after-restart rule. Give StateMachine an Unknown start state so Step becomes a plain desired-vs-applied diff.
candidates.removes: a second copy of the withdraw rule and two flags in the prober

candidates.claim: The comment on NewStateMachine names Prober.seed, which does not exist; the after-restart rule is in Prober.Step.
